entities.name: Rin
entities.description: A dog who herds prey for Seri.

entities.name: Seri
entities.description: A cat who finishes the prey Rin herds.

events.summary: Rin and Seri, both abandoned young, meet, grow from wary to inseparable partners.
events.quote: At first they were wary of each other, but from now on they will never be parted.

relations.quote: the dog Rin herds the prey while the cat Seri moves in to finish it off
